reason: B offers the clearer and more testable transformation pathway—precipitation from a rapidly solidified supersaturated matrix—with explicit corrosion and oxidation metrics and phase/scale characterization against an as-cast baseline. Its proposed benefit remains mechanistically uncertain because Mg-rich intermetallics can instead intensify galvanic corrosion and Mg-rich oxides are not necessarily protective, but it is better grounded and more decisive than A’s vague claim that coarsening induces protective Ti/Cu/Zn-oxide-forming segregation.
